відповідь.body: {"content":[{"type":"text","text":"Wool-blend turtleneck in a deep charcoal gray (#2F3136), relaxed but structured fit reaching mid-thigh, matte finish. High-waisted wide-leg trousers in black crepe (#000000), full length with a slight taper at the ankle for easy movement through crowds. Leather pumps in a classic pointed toe style, black leather (#000000), mid-heel height for stability on dance floors and outdoor stages. A structured blazer in matching charcoal wool, single-button closure, tailored waist to balance the wide legs and add polish without restricting arm movement. This outfit honors her request for \"strimano i klasichno\" by sticking to a monochromatic neutral palette of black and charcoal, ensuring she looks polished rather than flashy amidst club lighting. The high-rise trousers and structured jacket provide a professional silhouette that feels grounded even when dancing in a dense crowd, avoiding the risk of looking too casual or overly revealing. While a concert often invites bold colors, her intent for timeless elegance is met here through fabric texture and clean lines that read as sophisticated against any stage backdrop."}],"usage":{"input_tokens":1035,"output_tokens":231},"stop_reason":"end_turn"}
